name: --adaptive
help: Enable adaptive fallback: if one tool detects far fewer circRNAs than another (< --adaptive-ratio), automatically lower min_tools to 1 to avoid near-zero recall

name: --adaptive-ratio
help: Threshold for adaptive fallback: if min(tool_counts) / max(tool_counts) < ratio, trigger single-tool mode (default: 0.1)

name: --case-label
help: Label for the case/treatment group (default: tumor)

name: --circbase-file
help: Local circBase hg19 file (auto-downloaded if absent)

name: --components-json
help: JSON dict: {component: {enabled, weight}} for sig/fc/conf/known/mirna/rbp. Default: all enabled, weight 1.0 (equal, this paper's setting).

name: --control-label
help: Label for the control group (default: normal)

name: --count-matrix
help: BSJ count matrix TSV (row names: chrom:start|end)

name: --cross-method-min
help: Minimum number of DE methods (of those supplied) in which a candidate must be significant to count as cross-method (default 3 = all supplied).

name: --de-deseq2
help: DESeq2 DE results TSV (optional; for n_sig_methods)

name: --de-edger
help: edgeR DE table (required unless edgeR is the primary, in which case --de is used)

name: --de-limma
help: limma DE results TSV (optional; for n_sig_methods)

name: --exclude
help: Dataset to drop for the sensitivity analysis

name: --fully-evaluated-only
help: Also write <output>_fully_evaluated.tsv (or --fully-evaluated-output path) containing only candidates with interaction_queried=True, re-ranked within that evidence-consistent subset. Does not replace the main --output file.

name: --fully-evaluated-output
help: Output path for the fully-evaluated-only TSV (default: <output> with _fully_evaluated inserted before the extension)

name: --gse
help: GEO or SRA accession: GSE113230 / PRJNA808398 / SRP156355

name: --gtf
help: Reference GTF for exon boundary lengths (optional)

name: --inputs
help: biomarker_candidates.tsv paths (name inferred from *_results/ path); or NAME=path pairs to set the name explicitly

name: --interactions
help: interactions.json from predict_interactions (optional; adds miRNA/RBP dimensions)

name: --interactive
help: Prompt user for each sample's condition

name: --isoforms
help: isoform_groups.tsv (assign_isoforms.py): adds gene_name and region to the candidate file

name: --log
help: Pipeline log 檔路徑（failure 用）

name: --loo-dir
help: Directory from scripts/loo_stability.R (NONE/ + one dir per dropped sample). If given, effect-size stability is tested for three-method candidates; otherwise effect_stable is NA.

name: --max-junction-ratio
help: Max BSJ/FSJ ratio for CIRIquant pseudo-circ QC (default: 1.0)

name: --metadata-root
help: Root dir holding per-dataset subdirs (default: metadata)

name: --min-bsj
help: Minimum BSJ reads per tool before voting (default: 2)

name: --min-confidence
help: Minimum confidence score threshold after voting (default: 0.0). Removes low-evidence circRNAs to improve precision.

name: --no-run-params
help: Do not write interaction coverage into <results>/run_params.yaml. Required for v2 runs so published results directories are not modified.

name: --out
help: Optional TSV of every sample's verdict

name: --primary-method
help: Which method's table is --de (the scored table). The cross-method flag and LOO gate are the same whichever method is primary.

name: --qc-bsj-threshold
help: BSJ count threshold: only apply ratio QC when BSJ < this value (default: 5). High-BSJ circRNAs are exempt from ratio filtering.

name: --rule
help: 失敗的 rule 名稱（failure 用）

name: --slop
help: bp tolerance when matching novel circRNAs across datasets (default 10)

name: --stability-min-ratio
help: A dropped-sample run fails if |log2FC_run| < ratio*|log2FC_full| (default 0.5, i.e. a drop of more than 50%%). Sign flips always fail.

name: --status-json
help: Write an explicit run status JSON (status, counts, parameters) here.

name: --summary
help: One or more consensus_summary.tsv files from consensus_filter.py

name: --top-n
help: Only consider each dataset's top-N ranked candidates (0 = all, default)

name: config.de.de_sig_by (published projects)
help: observed 2026-10-04 on server: grep de_sig_by ~/circRNA_agent/config/projects/*.yaml; config.yaml default is auto -- the two disagree

name: config.circbase_file
help: leave empty for auto-download; or set local path

name: config.consensus.adaptive
help: default True matches what every published dataset actually ran with

name: config.consensus.min_confidence
help: consensus_filter.py --min-confidence; previously never wired into circrna.smk

name: config.consensus.qc_bsj_threshold
help: only apply ratio QC when BSJ < this; high-BSJ circRNAs exempt

name: config.de.biomarker.fc_cap
help: |log2FC| cap in rank_biomarkers.py fc_norm; was hardcoded

name: config.de.biomarker.sig_cap
help: -log10(p) cap in rank_biomarkers.py sig_norm; was hardcoded

name: config.de.de_sig_by
help: auto = q<0.2 (Storey) then p<0.05; pvalue/padj = fixed

name: config.de.deseq2_size_factor_type
help: estimateSizeFactors(type=); was unconditionally hardcoded in analysis.R

name: config.de.filter_expr_min_count
help: edgeR filterByExpr min.count; was hardcoded in analysis.R

name: config.de.filter_expr_min_total_count
help: edgeR filterByExpr min.total.count (edgeR's own implicit default, now explicit)

name: config.de.heatmap_top_n
help: top N up + N down circRNAs shown in heatmap

name: config.de.interaction_top_n
help: top N circRNAs to query ENCORI for interactions

name: config.de.isoform_fdr_cutoff
help: within-gene FDR for isoform switching (less strict than global)

name: config.de.paired_design_override
help: auto = detect patient_id column; force_paired/force_unpaired to override

name: config.tools.ciriquant.anchor
help: -a/--anchor: min anchor length for junction alignment

name: config.tools.ciriquant.no_gene
help: --no-gene: skip stringtie gene abundance (speed only; no effect on circRNA calls)

name: config.tools.dcc.threads
help: -T; was hardcoded in circrna.smk. benchmark/config_benchmark.yaml pins this
